messages:
kai: Heads-up — GPU CI on main started failing after the image bump earlier today. Lots of jobs hitting undefined symbol errors from libcuda/libcudart. Anyone seen this? Example log:

ci-bot: [CI] job gpu-inference-p3 failed — logs: https://ci.redwood/ci/job/12345

kai: log snippet:
```
ImportError: undefined symbol: cuStreamAddCallback
  File "/workspace/venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/torch/_C.so", line ...
```

eric: @kai I saw something similar in a local repro. We switched nvidia-container-toolkit in the image to 1.11 -> 1.12 which tied to driver 535.*. Maybe driver/ABI mismatch with CUDA 11.7 runtime in the container.

maria: Flaky across p3 but A100 runners pass. Suspect driver/ABI. P3s use older AMI drivers vs A100 instances which have newer stack. Can someone bisect the image layers?

jen: I can bisect. What's the exact docker command to repro locally?

kai: `docker run --gpus all --rm -it --entrypoint /bin/bash redwood/gpu-image:latest` then run `python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"` — fails with undefined symbol.

jen: starting bisect now. Will try previous images from 2026-03-01..2026-03-10 range.

deploy-bot: rerun triggered by jen — rerunning gpu-inference-p3 job #12346

jen: bisect results: regression introduced by image build job that upgraded nvidia-container-toolkit + installed driver 535.104.05; commit 9f7a2b5 (image: bump nct to 1.12, driver 535).

eric: confirms — repro with `LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so python -c ...` shows symbol missing. Looks like the bundled libcudart in the container expects an older driver ABI.

maria: short term fix: pin toolkit/driver in the base image to 470.x or rollback the image bump. Also add a CI matrix to test driver combos.

kai: I'll open a rollback PR to revert the image change and pin to driver 470. Also adding a follow-up issue to add canary tests across p3/a100 and explicit driver/runtime combos.

jen: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/images/pull/198 — includes revert + test tweak. Rerun requested.

ci-bot: [CI] gpu-inference-p3 rerun #12346 started — link https://ci.redwood/ci/job/12346

eric: :thumbsup: let's also add a note to the release checklist: "confirm driver vs CUDA runtime compatibility".

maria: agreed. I'll add a small smoke test to the infra image job that runs `python -c "import torch; torch.zeros(1).cuda()"` on both p3 and a100.

kai: thanks all. If reruns pass we'll merge rollback and schedule a follow-up to investigate how toolkit upgrade slipped by.

jen: rerun passed on p3, looks clean. last failing commit reverted.

kai: great — resolving for now. Follow-ups: infra smoke, driver matrix, and gating image upgrades behind canary. :eyes:
